## Fishing on the Open Ocean

Deep-sea fishing offers a day on the water and a view of Rio from the Atlantic. Dark seawater moves alongside the boat, the coast gradually recedes, and your attention turns to your fishing tackle. While waiting for a bite, there is time to watch the waves and discover how different the city feels from a distance.

The most memorable moments are often brief: the line pulls taut and you have to react with focus and precision. Between these moments, there is sea air and an open horizon. The catch depends on sea conditions, the season and fish behavior. The outing itself appeals to anyone who enjoys active recreation on the water and is ready to spend an extended period aboard.

The excursion lasts 12 hours according to the itinerary. Fuel, fishing equipment and snacks with non-alcoholic drinks are included. Bring suitable clothing, headwear, sunglasses and sunscreen. Alcoholic drinks are charged separately.

## Excursion Terms

ADVENTURE FISHING-style boarding, fuel, fishing equipment and snacks are included: sandwiches, water, isotonic drinks and soft drinks.

## Panoramas of Bartolome

Bartolome feels like an alien world surrounded by the vast ocean, where every step traces ancient volcanoes and each new view reveals magnificent panoramas worthy of an artist's brush. From the island's summit, you will see crystal-clear waters framed by dramatic outlines of cliffs and islands, with famous Pinnacle Rock at the center of the scene. Bartolome is a place where nature has created genuine masterpieces, and every sunset over its landscapes will stay in your memory forever.

Set out for Bartolome. You will climb for about 30 minutes through an almost lunar landscape to reach the volcanic island's highest point. From there, enjoy striking views of Santiago, North Seymour, Baltra, Santa Cruz, Rabida and tiny Chinese Hat Island, as well as the famous Pinnacle Rock, the remains of an ancient collapsed volcano. The island provides habitat for several bird species. The panorama from the summit is an emblematic Galapagos view that has been captured by many photographers.

## Beach and Snorkeling

As the tour continues, you will need to change clothes for the beach. During the boat trip, guests may spot Galapagos penguins, just 50 centimeters tall, standing at the foot of a cliff or darting through the crystal-clear ocean at extraordinary speed.

There will be time to relax on the beach or go snorkeling: the shallow waters allow you to swim and snorkel near Galapagos penguins, reef sharks, starfish, rays, sea turtles and an abundance of colorful tropical fish. You may also see some of the island's endemic species, including marine iguanas, sea lions and pelicans, among others.

The transfer to the port takes approximately 20 minutes.

The boat journey along the Beagle Channel then takes about 2 hours.

Magellanic penguins return to the island from late September.

Gentoo penguins may also be seen.

Other birds found here include albatrosses, cormorants, petrels, vultures and South American terns.

The excursion is charged separately.

## Plaza Island Is:

## White sandy beaches, volcanic cliffs and turquoise waters, vibrant landscapes and abundant wildlife!

Board the yacht and depart for South Plaza Island. One of the smallest islands in the archipelago, it lies off the eastern tip of Santa Cruz Island. After an hour and a half at sea, Plaza greets visitors with a red-and-green carpet of endemic Sesuvium plants covering the island and the friendly barking of several resident sea lion families. The ocean's turquoise waters beautifully complement the white sandy beaches and volcanic formations along the shore. The island walk is very easy: the trail passes sea lions and land iguanas, then leads to the highest cliff, where the calls of swallow-tailed gulls cut through the air and solitary male sea lions, defeated in their struggle with rivals for a harem, retreat up an almost vertical slope. Meanwhile, tropical birds such as frigatebirds, blue-footed boobies and tropicbirds glide gracefully overhead. We recommend bringing binoculars to see this remarkable wildlife up close. The view from the highest point over the ocean and the powerful waves breaking against the rocks is unforgettable.

## Plaza Island: a small yet wonderfully scenic corner of the Galapagos archipelago!

## Vivid scenery and abundant wildlife on Plaza Island!

Plaza Island is a small yet wonderfully scenic part of the Galapagos archipelago, known for its colorful landscapes and rich wildlife. White sandy beaches, volcanic cliffs and turquoise waters line its coast, contrasting with the red-and-green carpet of endemic Sesuvium plants. The island is home to numerous sea lions, land iguanas and rare birds such as swallow-tailed gulls and frigatebirds, making it a paradise for wildlife enthusiasts. Walking around Plaza, you may see male sea lions that have lost a fight for a harem climbing the steep cliffs, while magnificent tropical birds circle overhead.
